entities.summary: Chhetri, historically called Kshettriya or Kshetriya or Khas are Nepali speaking people historically associated with the warrior class and administration, some of whom trace their origin to migration from medieval India. Chhetri was a caste of administrators, governors, warriors and military elites in the medieval Khas Kingdom and Gorkha Kingdom. The nobility of the Gorkha Kingdom mainly originated from Chhetri families. They also had a strong presence in civil administration affairs. The bulk of prime ministers of Nepal before the democratization of Nepal belonged to this caste as a result of the old Gorkhali aristocracy. Chhetri is a clan.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Chhetri clan played a crucial role in shaping Nepal's administration and governance, with many prime ministers belonging to this caste before the democratization of Nepal. Their influence on the country's nobility and civil service had lasting regional implications.
